grades: Sophomores, juniors and seniors in fall 2027
name: Driehaus Summer Business Institute
org: DePaul University, Driehaus College of Business
what_you_do: Take a one-week class with team projects in money, sales, business and accounting. You pitch a new idea for a business. You earn a business certificate.
who_can_apply: High school students who will be sophomores, juniors or seniors in fall 2027.
pay_detail: $1,000. DePaul alumni get a 10% discount for their high school student.
duration: One week, 27.5 hours of classes plus 5 hours of site visits
deadline_text: 2027 dates and sign-up are not posted yet. The page says to check back later. Late sign-ups go on a waitlist.
how_to_apply: 2027 sign-up is not open yet. Check the program page for updates. Questions: dsbi@depaul.edu, or admission@depaul.edu and (312) 362-8000. Classes are capped at 20 students.
notes: Costs money. The page does not list 2027 dates, a live-in option or scholarships. The fee includes lunch, a snack, a t-shirt and a business certificate.
